dict.string: Runningbord transcribes your side of a meeting from the microphone when you turn on "Also capture my microphone". Audio is processed on your device unless you choose a cloud transcription provider.
Runningbord captures a screenshot when you press the screenshot shortcut so the AI can see what you are looking at.
Runningbord records the last few minutes of your computer's audio (for example, the other people in a meeting) so it can transcribe them when you ask a question.
